claims.statement: For every complex Hadamard matrix S of order six in the specified two-circulant Szollosi family, there are no unitary matrices C,D for which {I,S/sqrt(6),C,D} is a set of four mutually unbiased bases.
claims.scope: Entire specified closed two-parameter family, including boundaries and degeneracies; not all order-six Hadamard matrices.
dependencies: IEEE binary64 interval kernel and compiler

claims.statement: The standard basis and any member of the two-parameter Fourier family cannot extend to a quadruplet of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six.
claims.scope: New checked implementation of the theorem of Jaming et al. (2009), not a new exclusion theorem.

claims.statement: If MMVW Conjecture 2 holds, the maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six is three.
claims.scope: Conditional consequence; the imported algebraic conjecture is not proved here.

assurance.novelty: bounded retrospective source comparison, not exhaustive clearance
assurance.systemAssessment: review repairs implemented; full clean local replay passed both families including all required boundary subdivisions; semantic proof and toolchain trust remain separate layers
